app.name: Allumi

setup.title: Welcome to Allumi
setup.intro: Create the company and the administrator account. This page is disabled afterwards.
setup.tokenMissing: This instance is exposed to the Internet without a setup token: the first visitor could take it over. Add SETUP_TOKEN to the server's .env file (openssl rand -hex 16), then restart with docker compose up -d.
setup.tokenHint: It is in the server's .env file (SETUP_TOKEN) and in the message printed at the end of the installation.
setup.fiscalYearStart: First month of the fiscal year
setup.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A long passphrase beats a complicated password.
setup.submit: Create the company and get started

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.intro: Enter the code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code. Complete this step within 10 minutes of entering your password; after that, sign in again.

security.title: Account security
security.twoFactorOff: Off. Turn it on to protect your accounting data: it is recommended for every owner and accountant account.
security.twoFactorOn: On. {count, plural, =0 {You have no recovery codes left.} one {You have # recovery code left.} other {You have # recovery codes left.}}
security.scan: Scan this code with an authenticator app (Aegis, Google Authenticator, 1Password…), then enter the 6-digit code.
security.recoveryIntro: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each works once and they will not be shown again.
security.disableHint: Enter your password and a current code to turn off 2FA.
security.enrollPasswordHint: To turn it on, also enter your password: a stolen session cookie is not enough to enroll another device.
security.passwordHint: Enter your current password, then a new one (at least {min} characters). Your other devices will be signed out.
security.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.
security.sessionsIntro: These are the devices where your account is open. Disconnect the ones you do not recognise, then change your password.

dashboard.title: {company}
dashboard.noCompany: Your account is not a member of any company.
dashboard.accountsHint: The company's accounts, their type and their status.
dashboard.journalHint: Every entry, manual entries and reversals.
dashboard.fiscalHint: Fiscal years and their periods: locking and reopening.
dashboard.trialHint: Totals by account, with the balance check.
dashboard.auditHint: Who did what and when, without exception.
dashboard.emptyTitle: A fresh start for your books
dashboard.emptyHint: Posted entries will appear here. Start with an opening balance or a manual entry.
dashboard.healthHint: Total debits equal total credits, and assets equal liabilities plus equity and net income when both checks pass.

contacts.notFound: This contact was not found or has been anonymized.
contacts.anonymizeInvalid: Choose a reason and confirm the anonymization.
contacts.twoFactorRequired: Turn on two-factor authentication (Account security) to anonymize a contact.

catalog.invalid: Check the fields, amounts, dates and taxes for the selected treatment.
catalog.reference: Choose active accounts and codes belonging to this company, of the requested type.
catalog.conflict: This code already exists or rate periods overlap.
catalog.notFound: This item or code was not found.
catalog.futureRate: Choose a future date after the latest rate, without an already posted document on or after that date.

company.invalidProfile: The company details are invalid: check the fields.

invalid.name: The company name is required (120 characters at most).
invalid.gstNumber: The GST/HST number must be nine digits, "RT" and four digits (e.g. 123456789 RT 0001).
invalid.qstNumber: The QST number must be ten digits, "TQ" and four digits (e.g. 1234567890 TQ 0001).
invalid.businessNumber: The federal business number has nine digits.
invalid.postalCode: The postal code is not valid (e.g. H2X 1Y4).
invalid.email: The email address is not valid.

sales.invalid: Check dates, lines and amounts. The total must be positive; at most 50 lines.
sales.reference: Choose active customers, items, income accounts and tax codes belonging to this company.
sales.rate: A tax rate is missing on this date, or calculations do not agree. Check tax settings.
sales.stale: This draft was changed, deleted or posted elsewhere. Reload it before continuing.
sales.confirmPost: Confirm final posting of the invoice.
sales.invalidVoid: Enter a reason of 1–500 characters and a date on or after the posting date.
sales.linked: This invoice has linked payments or credit notes. Resolve them before voiding.
sales.invalidCredit: Enter a reason and a positive amount on at least one line, without exceeding the original amount or two decimal places.
sales.creditSource: Choose a posted invoice and a date on or after its posting date.
sales.creditLimit: Combined credit notes exceed the original invoice amounts. Review the lines and taxes.
sales.creditBalance: The invoice balance is insufficient to apply this credit note in full.
sales.confirmCreditPost: Confirm posting and applying this credit note.
sales.confirmCreditVoid: Confirm permanently voiding the credit note.
sales.creditVoidDate: The void date cannot precede posting, an application or its removal.
sales.creditVoidLinked: An active refund or application to another invoice prevents voiding.

members.invalid: Check the email, role and permissions.
members.exists: This person is already a member of the company.
members.notFound: This access or invitation no longer exists.
members.self: Another administrator must change your access. The last administrator must be retained.
members.password: Enter a name and a password of at least 12 characters, different from the email.
members.invitationInvalid: Invalid, expired, revoked or already used invitation. If the account exists, sign in with the invited email before trying again.
members.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
members.dependencies: Incompatible permissions: see the dependencies shown in the form.

integrations.invalid: Check the name, the account, the date and the keys. A Stripe key starts with sk_ or rk_ (not pk_).
integrations.importFrom: Choose a real day, not in the future (PayPal: no more than three years back).
integrations.account: Choose an active bank-type account of this company.
integrations.labelTaken: A connection of this service already has this name.
integrations.unauthorized: The service refused these credentials. Check the key or the secret.
integrations.forbidden: The service refuses access: check the key's permissions (read balance transactions for Stripe, Transaction Search for PayPal).
integrations.rateLimited: The service asks you to wait. Try again in a few minutes.
integrations.unavailable: The service cannot be reached right now. Try again later.
integrations.invalidResponse: The service's answer is not in the expected format: nothing was imported for this period. Try again; if it persists, report it.
integrations.tooMany: This period holds too many transactions for one sync.
integrations.busy: A sync of this connection is already running.
integrations.disabled: This connection is disabled. Reconnect it with new keys.
integrations.credentials: The stored keys cannot be read. Replace them.
integrations.environment: These keys are not from the same environment (test or live) as the connection.

payments.invalid: Check the amount (positive, at most two decimals), the date, the account and the payment method.
payments.invoiceNotOpen: Only a posted, non-voided invoice can receive a payment.
payments.stale: The balance of this invoice changed after the form was shown. Reload the page and check the balance.
payments.exceeds: The amount is more than the invoice's remaining balance.
payments.dateBeforeInvoice: The date received cannot precede the invoice's accounting date.
payments.futureDate: The date received cannot be in the future.
payments.account: Choose an active bank account, cash account or "Undeposited funds".
payments.invalidVoid: Give a reason of 1 to 500 characters and a date on or after the payment and its applications.
payments.confirmVoid: Confirm the permanent voiding of the payment.

onlinePayments.nothingDue: This invoice has no balance left to pay.
onlinePayments.amountRange: Stripe accepts payments from $0.50 to $999,999.99: the balance of this invoice is outside that range.
onlinePayments.currency: Online payment is only offered in Canadian dollars.
onlinePayments.feeAccount: Choose the processing fee account in the Stripe connection first.
onlinePayments.feeAccountInvalid: Choose an active expense account of this company.
onlinePayments.provider: Only Stripe offers online payment for now.
onlinePayments.linkExists: This invoice already has a live link for another balance or another connection. Cancel it first.
onlinePayments.linkChanged: This link changed in the meantime. Reload the page.
onlinePayments.amount: The amount paid is not the amount of the link.
onlinePayments.fee: The fees reported by Stripe do not agree with the amount paid.
onlinePayments.settlementCurrency: Stripe settled this payment in a currency other than Canadian dollars: record it by hand.
onlinePayments.rule: The books refused the entry (a locked period, for example).

banking.invalid: Check the account and the file.
banking.tooLarge: The file is over 4 MB or has too many lines (20,000 at most).
banking.unreadable: The file could not be read: an unclosed quote, a cell that is too long, too many columns or an unknown format.
banking.noTransactions: This file holds no transaction to import.
banking.mapping: Choose the columns of the file: date, description and amount.
banking.currency: This statement is not in Canadian dollars: Allumi keeps its books in a single currency.
banking.unreadableRows: Some lines of the file are unreadable: fix the columns or the file. The preview points them out.
banking.account: Choose an active bank, cash or credit card account of this company.
banking.alreadyImported: This file was already imported on this account.
banking.transactionNotFound: Transaction not found or already matched.
banking.notUnmatched: This transaction is already matched or set aside.
banking.noLines: Tick at least one journal line.
banking.tooManyLines: A transaction is not matched to more than 20 lines at a time.
banking.sumMismatch: The ticked lines do not add up to the transaction’s amount.
banking.lineNotFound: One of the ticked lines is not on this transaction’s account.
banking.lineTaken: One of those lines is already matched to another transaction.
banking.lineReconciled: A completed bank reconciliation already counts one of those lines: reopen it before undoing the match.
banking.sameAccount: Choose an account other than the transaction’s own.
banking.alreadyRecorded: An entry already stands for this transaction: match it instead of making another, or reverse it first.
banking.transferAccount: The two lines of a transfer must be on two different accounts.
banking.transferAmounts: The two lines of a transfer must have opposite amounts.
banking.reconInvalid: Check the account, the statement date and its balance (an amount, two decimals at most).
banking.reconInProgress: A reconciliation is already in progress on this account: complete it or abandon it first.
banking.reconDateOrder: The statement date must be after that of the account’s last completed reconciliation.
banking.reconCompleted: This reconciliation is completed: it no longer changes (reopen it if it is the account’s latest).
banking.reconLine: One of the lines is not a line of this account.
banking.reconLineLate: One of the lines is dated after the statement.
banking.reconLineTaken: One of the lines is already counted by another reconciliation.
banking.reconTooMany: This account has too many lines to tick on one sheet (5,000 at most).
banking.reconDifference: The difference is not zero: the saved ticked lines do not give the statement’s balance. Save the ticks, then check the difference.
banking.reconNotLatest: Only the latest completed reconciliation of an account can be reopened.
banking.reconReason: Write the reason for reopening (at least ten characters).

reports.period: The period is not valid: both days must exist and the start must come before the end.
reports.account: Choose an account of this company.
reports.tooManyLines: The period has too many entries for one file (200,000 lines at most): choose a shorter period or a single account.

ledgerSetup.title: Set up the books
ledgerSetup.intro: This company has no chart of accounts or fiscal year yet. A starter chart for a small Canadian business and the current fiscal year will be created; you can change everything afterwards.
ledgerSetup.notAllowed: Ask an owner or an accountant to set up the books.

accounts.title: Chart of accounts
accounts.name: Name
accounts.systemHint: System accounts (receivables, payables, undeposited funds, retained earnings, opening balances) are used by the engine: they cannot be deleted or deactivated.
accounts.codeHint: Letters, digits, dot or hyphen (20 characters at most).
accounts.typeFrozen: The code, names and description can change. The type and subtype stay: they give meaning to the account's history. To change them, delete the account if it was never used, then create it again.
accounts.backToList: Back to the chart of accounts

journal.title: Journal
journal.total: {count, plural, =0 {No entries} one {# entry} other {# entries}}

entry.title: New journal entry
entry.immutable: A posted entry cannot be edited: it is reversed and a new one is entered.
entry.openingHint: For opening balances, enter every account and balance with “Equity – opening balances”. Customers and suppliers go through opening invoices.

problems.unreadable: An amount cannot be read: at most two decimals.
problems.missingAccount: Choose an account for every line that has an amount.
problems.tooFewLines: At least two lines with an amount are needed.
problems.tooManyLines: An entry has at most 500 lines.
problems.tooLarge: An amount is above the maximum.
problems.bothSides: Line {line} has a debit and a credit: one side per line.

entryDetail.title: Entry {number}
entryDetail.reverseHint: A mirror entry is created and balances return to what they were. Nothing is deleted.
entryDetail.voidHint: This entry comes from a document (invoice, payment, deposit): correct it by voiding the document.
entryDetail.bankHint: This entry was made from a bank transaction. To correct it, reverse it, then undo the transaction’s match to deal with it again.

fiscal.title: Fiscal years
fiscal.reopenHint: Reopening the past is a privileged action: owner only, two-step verification on, a code from your authenticator app typed now, and a reason. It is written to the audit trail.
fiscal.createPast: Create the year that contains the date
fiscal.pastDate: A date within the year to create
fiscal.pastHint: For opening balances in the past: the year that contains this date is created.
fiscal.reasonFor: Reason for reopening period {number} (at least 10 characters)
fiscal.codeHint: The six-digit code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code. A code works only once.
fiscal.closeNamed: Close the fiscal year from {start} to {end}
fiscal.reopenYearNamed: Reopen the fiscal year from {start} to {end}
fiscal.reasonForYear: Reason for reopening the fiscal year from {start} to {end} (at least 10 characters)
fiscal.codeForYear: Verification code to reopen the fiscal year from {start} to {end}

trial.title: Trial balance
trial.balanced: The trial balance is balanced: total debits = total credits.
trial.notBalanced: ALERT: the trial balance is not balanced. Contact an administrator: this should never happen.
trial.equation: Accounting equation checked: assets = liabilities + equity + (revenue − expenses).
trial.equationBroken: ALERT: the accounting equation does not hold.
trial.netHint: Each account shows its net balance, in the debit or the credit column.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.intro: Every creation, change or deletion is written here by the database itself. Read-only: nothing is erased.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.intro: Your customers and suppliers in one directory.
contacts.countryHint: Two-letter country code, for example CA.
contacts.archiveHint: Archiving hides this contact from the active list and preserves accounting references. It can be restored; no data is deleted.
contacts.anonymizeIntro: Permanently erases this contact’s personal information: name, contact details, notes and registration numbers, in the record and in the audit trail. This cannot be undone.
contacts.anonymizeKept: Accounting documents are kept: a posted invoice keeps its frozen copy of the customer’s details, because accounting records must be retained. Entries, amounts and taxes do not change.
contacts.anonymizeNeedsTwoFactor: Owner only, with two-factor authentication turned on (Account security).
contacts.anonymizeCodeHint: The six-digit code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code. A code works only once.
contacts.anonymizeConfirm: I understand the erasure is permanent.
contacts.anonymized: Contact anonymized. Their personal information was erased from the record and the audit trail.
contacts.count: {count, plural, =0 {No contacts} one {# contact} other {# contacts}}
contacts.emptyHint: Change the filters or create a contact if your role permits it.

ventes.title: Sales
ventes.description: Prepare invoice drafts and find your customers and items.
ventes.planned: Sending, refunds and receiving payments are not yet available.

depenses.title: Expenses
depenses.description: Find suppliers and consult the journal.
depenses.planned: Supplier bills, expenses and disbursements: batches 4.4 and 4.5.

banque.title: Banking and transactions
banque.description: Open your chart of accounts and recorded entries.
banque.planned: CSV/OFX import and bank reconciliation: phase 5. No automatic bank feed currently.

tresorerie.title: Cash flow
tresorerie.description: Consult accounting balances and journal movements.
tresorerie.planned: Cash flow reporting and payment tracking: batch 4.5 and phase 6. No cash forecasts currently.

rapports.title: Reports
rapports.description: Consult the reports available for your company.
rapports.planned: GST/QST summary, payables aging, period comparisons and PDF exports: phase 6.

taxes.title: Taxes
taxes.description: Find tax accounts in your chart of accounts.
taxes.planned: Returns, summaries and GST/QST remittances in a later release.

comptabilite.title: Accounting
comptabilite.description: Your accounts, journal, trial balance and fiscal years in one place.

projets.title: Projects
projets.description: Project accounting is a possible future addition.
projets.planned: Scope and priority to be defined; project tracking is not available currently.

paie.title: Payroll
paie.description: Payroll management is a possible future addition.
paie.planned: Outside the MVP: salaries, deductions and remittances are not available.

kilometrage.title: Mileage
kilometrage.description: Travel tracking is a possible future addition.
kilometrage.planned: Scope to be defined; no trip log or allowance calculation currently.

applications.title: Apps
applications.planned: Public API and connectors: after the MVP, scope to be defined. No installable app catalogue currently.

updates.title: Versions and updates
updates.web: The web UI updates with the server. Reload the page after a restart. Windows clients have their own update menu.
updates.upToDate: Up to date for this channel ({version}).
updates.unavailable: Update check unavailable. Try again later.
updates.noRelease: No published release for this channel.
updates.confirm: I have saved my work. Updating creates a backup and interrupts service for all users.

status.disabled: Update agent not enabled. Follow the VM installation guide.

status.ready: Agent configured. Verify its service is running in the VM.

catalog.itemIntro: Set prices, accounts and taxes for your products and services. Inventory tracking is not available.
catalog.name: Item name
catalog.priceHint: Nonnegative amount, up to six decimals, without thousands separators.
catalog.truncated: Showing the first 100 results. Refine your search.
catalog.taxIntro: Configure the taxes applicable to your business and their effective dates. Enter rates as percentages; no tax is applied automatically. Tax returns will be added in a later release.
catalog.percentHint: Input examples: 5 or 9.975. Verify the applicable rate and date.
catalog.scheduleHint: The date must be after today and after the latest rate. The previous rate ends the day before; past periods stay unchanged.
catalog.previewHint: Preview using the rates on the selected date. No journal entry or invoice is created.
catalog.previewUnavailable: Choose a code and valid values, with an effective rate for every tax on this date.

companyPage.title: Company
companyPage.intro: Set the identity and contact details for your documents. Only the owner can edit them. Invoicing is not yet available.
companyPage.readOnly: Only the owner can change these details.
companyPage.name: Company name
companyPage.taxRoundingHint: Copied onto each document when it is created: changing it does not affect existing documents.
companyPage.fiscalYearStart: The fiscal year starts in {month}. It is set when the company is created.

sales.title: Invoice drafts
sales.intro: Prepare invoices, then post them to the ledger. A draft does not change the ledger. Sending and payments are not yet available.
sales.saveHint: Totals are recalculated when saved using the rates effective on the invoice date. Nothing is added to the ledger.
sales.lineHint: Positive quantity, up to four decimal places; nonnegative price, up to six decimal places. Choose an explicit tax code, including for tax-free lines.
sales.limit: Showing the first 100 results. Refine your search.
sales.optionsLimit: Selectors show the first 500 active customers and items.
sales.setupHint: Before creating a draft, add an active customer, an income account and a tax code in Contacts, Chart of accounts and Taxes.
sales.confirmDelete: I confirm permanent deletion of this draft.
sales.postHint: This assigns a final number and posts the invoice to the ledger. The document will be locked; corrections require an eligible void. Credit notes allow partial corrections.
sales.confirmPost: I confirm the amounts and final posting.
sales.postedHint: The details below were frozen when posted. Sending and payments are not yet available.
sales.confirmVoid: I confirm permanently voiding this invoice.
sales.voidWarning: Voiding keeps the invoice and creates a reversal in an open period. Linked payments and credit notes prevent this operation.
sales.voidHint: The amounts below belong to the original invoice. Its accounting effect has been reversed.
sales.postedLimit: The 100 most recently posted invoices are shown, including voided invoices.

credits.title: Credit note drafts
credits.intro: Prepare a correction without affecting the ledger, then post the credit note to record it and reduce its original invoice balance.
credits.amountHint: Enter the amount before tax to credit for each line, with up to two decimal places. Leave 0 to exclude a line. Tax rates and rounding come from the original invoice. Drafts do not reserve any amount.
credits.limit: Showing the 100 most recent credit note drafts.
credits.empty: No credit note drafts. Open a posted invoice to prepare a correction.
credits.sourceUnavailable: The original invoice is no longer posted. This draft remains readable and can be deleted, but cannot be edited.
credits.confirmDelete: I confirm deletion of this credit note draft.
credits.postedLimit: Showing the 100 most recent posted or voided credit notes.
credits.postedHint: Posted amounts are locked. Voiding retains the credit note, its journal entry and application history.
credits.postWarning: This assigns a number, posts the credit note and applies its full amount to the original invoice. Amounts will be locked; correction requires an eligible void. Check the amounts, reason and date; an insufficient balance or amounts already credited will be refused.
credits.confirmPost: I confirm posting and fully applying this credit note.
credits.voidWarning: This removes applications to the original invoice and creates a reversal in an open period. An active refund or application to another invoice prevents voiding.
credits.confirmVoid: I confirm permanently voiding this credit note.
credits.voidHint: This credit note was voided. The amounts below are retained for history; they no longer reduce the invoice balance.

members.title: Users and permissions
members.intro: Manage access to this company. Roles provide starting profiles; module permissions let you customize them.
members.superAdmin: You are a super administrator of this instance. Company permissions and server access are separate.
members.permissionHint: Admin: full access. Viewer: read access at most. Sales write access requires Accounting write access and at least read access to Contacts, Products and Taxes. Audit requires read access to every module. Reading Sales requires Contacts, Products, Accounting and Taxes read access; Products requires Accounting and Taxes, and Taxes requires Accounting.
members.share: Copy this code now and share it privately with the recipient. It expires in seven days.
members.sharePath: The recipient opens /invitation on this server. No email is sent automatically.
members.self: Your account: another administrator must change your access.
members.removeHint: Removes access to this company only. Accounting records and audit history are retained.
members.existing: Signed in: the invitation email must match your account. Your password stays unchanged.
members.newAccount: New account: enter the code you received and choose a password. If you already have an account, sign in first and return here.
members.signInFirst: I already have an account: sign in
members.name: Display name
members.limitedDashboard: Use the menu to open your authorized modules.
members.serverAccessHint: Includes backups of all companies and server updates. Grant only to trusted operators.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.intro: Connect Stripe or PayPal to import their transactions (payments, fees, refunds, payouts) into an inbox. Nothing is posted to the books automatically.
integrations.emptyOwner: Connect a service below to import its transactions.
integrations.emptyOther: The company owner can connect a service.
integrations.transactionCount: {count, plural, =0 {No transactions} one {# transaction} other {# transactions}}
integrations.ownerOnly: Only the owner connects a service, syncs it and replaces its keys.
integrations.noAccount: No bank-type account is active. Create one in the chart of accounts (for example "Stripe"), then come back.

hint.STRIPE: In Stripe, create a read-only restricted API key ("Balance transactions": read) and paste it here. Allumi checks the key, encrypts it and never shows it again. Imported transactions create no journal entries.
hint.PAYPAL: In PayPal Developer, create a REST app with the "Transaction Search" feature enabled, then copy the client ID and secret. PayPal's data can take up to three hours to show up.

integrations.accountHint: The service's balance is tracked in this account (bank type). If needed, first create a "Stripe" or "PayPal" bank-type account.
integrations.importFromHint: Transactions before this date are not imported. PayPal keeps three years of history.
integrations.apiKeyHint: It starts with sk_ or rk_. It is encrypted and never shown again.
integrations.clientSecretHint: It is encrypted and never shown again.
integrations.syncResult: {count, plural, =0 {Sync complete: no new transactions.} one {Sync complete: # transaction imported.} other {Sync complete: # transactions imported.}}
integrations.syncSkipped: {count, plural, one {# transaction skipped (currency without cents, or not settled).} other {# transactions skipped (currency without cents, or not settled).}}
integrations.syncMore: The history is long: run the sync again to continue.
integrations.keysReplaced: Keys replaced. The connection is active.
integrations.testNotice: Test connection (test keys or sandbox): its transactions are fictitious. Point it at a test account, not your real ones.
integrations.syncHint: Imports new transactions without creating journal entries. A long history continues when you run the sync again.
integrations.replaceHint: For a rotated key or to reconnect a connection. The new keys are checked with the service and must be from the same environment (test or live).
integrations.disconnectWarning: Disconnecting stops the import and erases the encrypted key. Transactions already imported are kept; you can reconnect with new keys.

transactions.count: {count, plural, =0 {No transactions} one {# transaction} other {# transactions}}
transactions.flagged: To check: the fee's sign is unusual for this service.
transactions.title: Bank transactions
transactions.intro: The lines of your statements (CSV or OFX files) and those Stripe and PayPal report. Match each one to a journal entry, record it, or link it to a transfer between your accounts.
transactions.importDone: {imported, plural, =0 {Import complete: no new transaction.} one {Import complete: # new transaction.} other {Import complete: # new transactions.}}
transactions.importDuplicates: {count, plural, one {# line was already on file and was left alone.} other {# lines were already on file and were left alone.}}
transactions.importSkipped: {count, plural, one {# empty or zero line was ignored.} other {# empty or zero lines were ignored.}}
transactions.emptyHint: Import a statement or connect a service.

payments.title: Payments received
payments.intro: Payments received from your customers, applied to posted invoices. Each payment adds an entry to the journal.
payments.emptyHint: Open a posted invoice to record a payment received.
payments.count: {count, plural, =0 {No payments} one {# payment} other {# payments}}
payments.none: No payment is applied to this invoice.
payments.paidInFull: This invoice is paid in full.
payments.recordHint: The amount cannot exceed the remaining balance. The money goes into the chosen account and accounts receivable goes down: an entry is added to the journal.
payments.amountHint: Up to the remaining balance, with at most two decimals.
payments.accountHint: A bank account, the cash account, or "Undeposited funds" until the deposit is made.
payments.voidWarning: Voiding keeps the payment and adds a reversing entry; the invoice's balance is restored. The date cannot precede the payment or its applications.
payments.confirmVoid: I confirm the permanent voiding of this payment.

onlinePayments.title: Online payment
onlinePayments.intro: Let your customer pay this invoice by card on a page hosted by Stripe. Allumi never sees the card number and needs no public address: you check afterwards whether the payment has arrived.
onlinePayments.addressLabel: Payment page address, to send to your customer
onlinePayments.pendingHint: This link could not be created at Stripe. Resume it or cancel it.
onlinePayments.reviewHint: A payment reached Stripe, but Allumi recorded nothing: {reason} If needed, record the payment by hand (it also appears in the imported transactions), then dismiss this notice.
onlinePayments.checkHint: Stripe does not notify Allumi: press here to record a payment that may have arrived.
onlinePayments.createHint: The link is for the current balance, {amount}, and for a single payment. If the balance changes, cancel it and create another.
onlinePayments.noConnection: No Stripe connection is ready. Connect Stripe, then choose the processing fee account.

cancelResult.cancelledOpen: Link cancelled here, but Stripe could not be reached (the connection is disconnected): close the page in your Stripe dashboard.
cancelResult.paid: A payment had just arrived: it was recorded, so the link is not cancelled.
cancelResult.review: A payment had just arrived but could not be recorded: see the notice below.

onlinePayments.collected: {paid, plural, =0 {Check complete: no new payment.} one {Check complete: # payment recorded.} other {Check complete: # payments recorded.}}
onlinePayments.collectedReview: {count, plural, one {# payment to review: open the invoice concerned.} other {# payments to review: open the invoices concerned.}}
onlinePayments.collectedExtra: {count, plural, one {# duplicate payment received on a link that was already paid: refund it in Stripe.} other {# duplicate payments received on links that were already paid: refund them in Stripe.}}
onlinePayments.collectedWaiting: {count, plural, one {# payment is still being processed at Stripe: check again later.} other {# payments are still being processed at Stripe: check again later.}}
onlinePayments.collectedFailed: {count, plural, one {# link could not be read this time (unexpected answer).} other {# links could not be read this time (unexpected answer).}}
onlinePayments.collectedMore: Some links are left to check: press again.
onlinePayments.feeAccountHint: The fees Stripe keeps on each online payment are booked to this expense account. Until it is chosen, no payment link is offered.
onlinePayments.feeAccountApplies: A change applies to the payments recorded from now on.
onlinePayments.keysHint: For online payment, the restricted key must also be able to write “Prices” and “Payment Links” and to read “Checkout Sessions” and “PaymentIntents”. Replace the key if needed.
onlinePayments.collectConnectionHint: Looks at the active payment links of this connection and records the payments received: the receipt at the gross amount, then the fees in an entry of their own. Nothing is recorded twice.

server.title: Server administration
server.intro: Global access is reserved for the super administrator and people they explicitly authorize.
server.hostSettings: Edit the address, port, proxies and secrets in the host .env file, then recreate the container. No secrets are displayed here.
server.backupHint: The agent creates a host backup using the existing configuration (encryption and off-site copy when configured). Archives are not exposed to the web container.
server.disabled: Enable the optional agent once from the Allumi folder on the server:
server.pending: Request pending or running. Reload this page to see the result.
server.ready: Agent enabled. Processing normally starts within one minute.
server.retentionHint: From 1 to 3650 days. Cleanup occurs with the next successful backup.
server.noBackups: No backups reported by the agent.
server.logsHint: Backup and configuration events, without command output or secrets. Detailed application logs remain available on the host using docker compose logs app.
server.awaiting: Agent configured, but no host snapshot received. Check the timer if this persists.

transactionDetail.title: Deal with a transaction
transactionDetail.readOnly: Only the owner and the accountant can deal with transactions.
transactionDetail.foreignCurrency: This line is in {currency}: the books are kept in Canadian dollars, so it cannot be matched or recorded here.
transactionDetail.excluded: This transaction is set aside: it is not in the books.
transactionDetail.undoHint: Undoing the match frees the transaction and the journal lines. An entry made from the transaction stays in the journal: reverse it if it was wrong.
transactionDetail.reconciledHint: A bank reconciliation already counts one of these lines: reopen it before undoing the match.
transactionDetail.matchIntro: Tick the journal lines on this account that correspond to this transaction. Their total must be exactly {amount}.
transactionDetail.noCandidates: No unmatched line on this account within {days} days of the transaction.
transactionDetail.window: Lines within {days} days of the transaction.
transactionDetail.matchLegend: Journal lines to match to this transaction
transactionDetail.picked: {count, plural, =0 {No line ticked} one {# line ticked} other {# lines ticked}}
transactionDetail.recordIn: Money received: the entry debits {account} and credits the account you choose, on the transaction’s date ({date}).
transactionDetail.recordOut: Money paid: the entry credits {account} and debits the account you choose, on the transaction’s date ({date}).
transactionDetail.transferIntro: If the money moved from one of your accounts to another (a card payment, a Stripe payout to the bank), link the two lines: a single entry records them, on the earlier of the two dates.
transactionDetail.noTransfers: No line of the opposite amount on another account within seven days.
transactionDetail.transferSubmit: Record the transfer with this line
transactionDetail.setAsideHint: Neither an entry nor a transfer: a duplicate line, or one that is not the books’ business.

reconciliation.title: Bank reconciliation
reconciliation.intro: Check a bank, cash or credit card account against the bank’s statement: tick the journal lines the statement confirms until the difference is zero. A completed reconciliation is frozen; only the latest can be reopened.
reconciliation.noAccounts: No active bank, cash or credit card account. Create one in the chart of accounts.
reconciliation.neverDone: No completed reconciliation for this account.
reconciliation.inProgress: Reconciliation in progress for the statement of {date}, balance
reconciliation.statementDateHint: The last day the statement covers. It follows the last completed reconciliation’s.
reconciliation.balanceHint: The closing balance the bank shows, as is (negative if the account is overdrawn).
reconciliation.balanceCardHint: What the card statement says you owe, as a positive amount.
reconciliation.history: {count, plural, one {# completed reconciliation} other {# completed reconciliations}}
reconciliation.unsaved: Unsaved changes: save the ticks before completing.
reconciliation.cardNote: Credit card: the balances are the statement’s (what you owe). Line amounts are their effect on the account: a purchase is negative, a payment positive.
reconciliation.tickIntro: Tick the journal lines the statement confirms. Offered are the lines of this account dated on or before {date} that no reconciliation has counted.
reconciliation.tickMatched: {count, plural, one {Tick the line matched to a transaction} other {Tick the # lines matched to transactions}}
reconciliation.noLines: No line to tick on this account at this date.
reconciliation.completeReady: The difference is zero: the saved ticks give the statement’s balance. Completing freezes this reconciliation.
reconciliation.completeWait: It can be completed when the saved difference is zero (current difference: {difference}).
reconciliation.discardHint: Abandoning removes this reconciliation’s ticks; nothing else changes.
reconciliation.reopenHint: Reopening this reconciliation lets you change the ticks and undo the matches of its lines. The reason goes to the audit trail.
reconciliation.reopenOnlyLatest: Only the latest completed reconciliation of an account can be reopened.

banking.title: Import a statement
banking.intro: Import the statement of a bank account or a credit card (CSV or OFX/QFX). The lines arrive in the bank transactions; no entry is created. A file that was already imported is refused and a line already on file is left as it is, so statements that overlap can be imported.
banking.accountHint: Bank, cash or credit card. The amount of a line is its effect on this account: money in is positive, money out is negative.
banking.noAccounts: No bank, cash or credit card account is active. Create one in the chart of accounts, then come back.
banking.fileHint: Up to 4 MB. The file is read in your browser for the preview, then read again by the server when you import.
banking.ofxInfo: Currency {currency} · account ending {mask} · closing balance stated {balance} on {date}
banking.summary: {count, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}} from {from} to {to} · money in {inflow} · money out {outflow}
banking.skipped: {count, plural, one {# empty or zero line will be ignored.} other {# empty or zero lines will be ignored.}}
banking.errorsTitle: {count, plural, one {# line is unreadable.} other {# lines are unreadable.}} Fix the columns below or the file; the import is refused while any remain.
banking.noMapping: Allumi did not recognise the columns of this file: choose them below.
banking.hasHeader: The first line is a header

amountKinds.split: Two columns (money out and money in)

banking.invert: Flip the signs (a card statement that shows a purchase as positive)
banking.recentLine: {file} · {date} · {count, plural, =0 {no new line} one {# new line} other {# new lines}}
banking.unreadable: This file could not be read.

statements.incomeIntro: Revenue less expenses over the chosen period, from the journal. Accounts that total zero are left out.
statements.balanceIntro: The company’s position on a given day, from the whole journal up to that day.
statements.incomeEmpty: No revenue or expense in the journal for this period.
statements.balanceEmpty: No journal entry up to this date.
statements.currentEarnings: Earnings of the current fiscal year
statements.balanced: The balance sheet balances: assets equal liabilities plus equity.
statements.notBalanced: The balance sheet does not balance: this is an incident to report.

ledgerReport.title: General ledger
ledgerReport.intro: The detail of an account over a period: its balance at the start, each journal line with the balance after it, its balance at the end. Balances are in the account’s usual direction (an asset or an expense grows with debits, the other accounts with credits).
ledgerReport.pickAccount: Choose an account to see its ledger, or export every account to a file.
ledgerReport.count: {count, plural, =0 {No line in this period} one {# line} other {# lines}}
ledgerReport.empty: No line of this account in this period.

aging.title: Receivables aging
aging.intro: What your customers owe you on a given day, by the number of days since each invoice fell due (or since its date when it has no due date). Payments and credit notes count from the day they were applied: the report for a past day gives what it was then.
aging.empty: No customer balance on this day.
aging.ledgerBalance: Receivable accounts balance in the general ledger
aging.agrees: The total agrees with the balance of the receivable accounts in the general ledger.
aging.differs: The total does not agree with the general ledger (difference of {amount}): the entries on the receivable accounts need to be checked.
